verdict.rationale: Superpowers is driven entirely through conversation inside the host coding agent. Skills auto-trigger from plain requests: "Fix this bug" invokes systematic-debugging, and saying "go" launches subagent development. The agent brainstorms in chat, asks clarifying questions and offers choices, and you can override its call. Community users confirm the conversational brainstorm/spec/plan flow and simply tell it to go. Missing for 10: independent evidence that natural-language auto-triggering is reliable across the supported harnesses, and NL operation depends on the host agent rather than the product itself.
